apps.title: SlowPulse
apps.description: SlowPulse puts a deliberate pause in front of shopping, doomscroll and food-delivery apps, labels what you were really doing, and shows you the money and time you kept.
apps.shortDescription: A one-second pause before the apps that empty your cart and your attention span.

apps.title: Budget Plant ID
apps.description: Point your camera at any plant and get the species, a care guide and a health check in seconds. No subscription — credit packs start at $0.99.
apps.shortDescription: Species, care guide and health check from one photo. Pay per identification, no subscription.

apps.title: Med Minder
apps.description: Med Minder keeps your medications and their schedules in one place and reminds you on time — scheduled on the device, so the alarm fires with no connection at all. Tap once to log a dose, swipe to skip, and see how the week actually went.
apps.shortDescription: Medication reminders that arrive on time, offline. Tap once to log the dose.

extensions.title: Auto Dark Mode
extensions.tagline: Dark mode on every site, automatically
extensions.description: Auto Dark Mode applies a clean, readable dark theme to any website that doesn't ship one, and gets out of the way on the sites that do. Flip it on and off per site, or let it follow your system's light/dark setting.
extensions.shortDescription: Automatic dark mode for every website, with per-site control.

extensions.title: SlowPulse for Chrome
extensions.tagline: A pause between the impulse and the tap
extensions.description: SlowPulse guards the sites you lose money and hours to. Every visit to one of them is interrupted by a single question first — what this purchase will solve, what's driving the order — and your answer is logged on your own machine, where the dashboard turns it into a streak and the money and time you kept.
extensions.shortDescription: One question in front of the sites that empty your cart and your evening.

saas.title: Mostlink
saas.tagline: One link for everything you make
saas.description: Mostlink is a link page builder for creators and small businesses. Put every link you care about — shop, socials, videos, newsletter — on one fast, customizable page, and share it from every bio you have.
saas.shortDescription: Build a single link page for all your links, and share it from every bio.
